steps.text: Twenty-six Years Ago...
5:11 P.M. \ Overcast
Residence of the Duke of Cumberland, Auchterigg District of Londinium

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: Your Majesty... I've just received word. Those two pitiful Members have died in their cells.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: An end they deserve. It's time Parliament understood they serve Victoria, and not the businessmen stuffing their pockets with coin.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: I understand your eagerness. Still, some are worried. Your pressure on the Court has terrified a great deal of Members who had been observing the situation. They may act with impropriety in days to come.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: They should be fearful! They'll better know their places.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: This unbroken succession of wars whiles away the riches our forebears accumulated over the ages, yet certain greedy condorwings have been reared—fattened by them.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: I'm not looking for you to back down, but if we could just go a little slower...

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: A little slower! As if the condorwings know when to stop. Why don't you look for them to feed a little slower?

spans.text: A little slower! As if the condorwings know when to stop. Why don't you look for

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: If we don't put our new tax policies in place, then once the enemy sees fit to pounce on Victoria and tear her flesh apart, even the mercenaries will leave us without a second thought!

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: If they consider themselves soldiers clear of mind and honorable of heart, they will stand by your side.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: I'm afraid the Red Dragon thought as much too, before he was forced to share half his crown.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: We all saw the end that befell him.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: I promise you, no matter the hour, you will have Cumberland's loyalty.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: Of course, 'Cumberland the Ever on High'—how could I doubt where you stand?

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: But you see, Robert, Victoria is in her hour of need, this very moment. The right of kings is waning upon this swathe of soil.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: Why does Your Majesty think so?

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: It's your birthday the day after. Everyone is hoping to catch a glimpse of your visage. The servicemen are impatient to pay their respects to you, and the populace's cheers are sure to drown out the parade in turn.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: This year, perhaps. But what of next year? And when it comes time for my Alexandrina to succeed the throne?

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: Robert, we will make our exit, sooner or later.

spans.text: make our exit, sooner or later.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: Your Majesty! You—

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Your Majesty, Your Grace.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Pardon me for bothering you without permission, but I've just had a report—

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: There has been an intrusion in the Palace underground. The Sighs of Kings is unaccounted for.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: And... so is Her Highness Alexandrina.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: The Guard have sealed off all areas of connection, and the search is underway, but no leads have surfaced for the time being.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: Her Highness Alexandrina and the Victorian Realmblade have gone missing at once, in this sensitive a situation?

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: No. No noble would be this brazen. But...

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: Your Majesty, I assure you, I will personally handle this affair, straight away. I'll...

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: Don't be flustered, my old friend. Alexandrina's long-time mentor accompanies her. I trust no one will pose a threat to her safety.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: Her mentor? As in...?

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: He treats Alexandrina very well. I can't recall if he's ever even shown me the same level of concern.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: As for our Sighs of Kings, no matter where it is, it will play its role.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: You mean... the role of a Realmblade?

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: Hah. It'll be grasped by a righteous ruler before those academics conduct their endless research on it. That is what a Realmblade stands for.

spans.text: Hah. It'll be grasped by a righteous ruler before those academics conduct their endless research on it.
is what a Realmblade stands for.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: And we all look forward to the coming of that day.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: Robert. For your daughter, and for mine.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: Yes, Your Majesty... and for Victoria.

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: Hold on, Miss, don't run so fast—

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I have to, Ailshie! I need to see my father!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I know he's at home today! If I'm not quick enough, he'll be off God-knows-where again!

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: The Duke's been up to his ears in business recently, but if he knows you want to meet him, I'm sure he'd be willing to spend the time with you.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I don't want him to spend time with me!

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: Then what are you in such a hurry to see him for?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I... I need to tell him, loud and clear, how I don't want to go to County York.

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: Don't you like the country? The manor out there's a lot more land than it is here. You used to love playing in the meadow, and you always had the farmers' kids there play cricket with you.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I love it there!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: But it's hardly even summer yet—this time of year, we usually stay in Londinium. Plus, isn't it strange to you how it's just me and Mum going this time?

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: Calm down for now. I hear from the Manchesters' butler how a lot of the noble houses' Masters and Mistresses are summering in the country early this year. It might just be one of those new trends in society, you know?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Don't give me that.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Ailshie, Dad's hiding from me. He wants me out of here. Why? Because I keep asking him to teach me swordsmanship, or because I can never get any Gaulish into my head? Is that why he has a temper at me?

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: Miss Allerdale, maybe it's not my place to say this, but...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Well, my manners tutor isn't here right now, and I don't give two tosses what you should be saying or not.

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: ...I can only offer my own opinion.

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: Miss, His Grace loves you very much. No matter what his decision is, it's going to be for the good of you and the Madam.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: If he wants good for me, that's more reason he shouldn't be sending me off.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I... I'll miss him. I'll miss him a lot, you know.

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: Ha, ha... Oh, come on, you. What's the blushing for?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Because that's the kind of thing only little kids say!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I don't want Dad to think I'm attached to him! I need to be stronger, and then I can become a Steam Knight sooner, just like my great-great-great-great-grandmother—

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: But, you know, you are a child still.

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: You should try telling him everything you've been feeling. He's a gentle, generous Duke, and a kind and caring father. I'm sure he'll understand you.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: So you'll let me see him?

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: I always support you in your decisions.

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: But you'd best be a little slower, so's you don't trip on the plants, or else Mr. Jim the gardener'll skip dinner again out of shame for getting you hurt.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Tell Jim it's his fault if his plants hurt me!

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: *sigh* Really, what do we do with you?

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: And make sure you mind your skirt, Miss Allerdale... You've got an audience with His Majesty at the dinner tonight!

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: Have you seen Charles Lynch anywhere?

steps.name: Noble Lady
steps.text: The newly appointed Steam Knight, was it...? Incredible achievement at his age. I'm sure plenty came here just to mob him.

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: Shame he rushed off not long after he arrived. I hear every Steam Knight garrisoned in Londinium got orders to move.

steps.name: Noble Lady
steps.text: ...Is it Sargon or Leithanien this time?

steps.name: Noble Lady
steps.text: God save Victoria, no more wars. Every time one happens, I have to sell off a few more of my grandfather's paintings, rest his soul.

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: It's an order direct from Parliament this time.

steps.name: Noble Lady
steps.text: ...Parliament?

steps.name: Noble Lady
steps.text: Oh, of course... the Steam Knights sit under Parliament, don't they? You always get word so quick.

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: The more you're informed, the better you invest, especially in these times. This goes far further than how much pound sterling we make or lose.

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: We're deciding the nation's future, and that's precisely why we need to be in touch with more of the wisest.

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: Major Lynch is...

steps.name: Noble Lady
steps.text: I think the proper title is Sir Charles now.

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: Sir Charles is a diligent and upstanding knight, loyal to our nation, to Victoria.

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: He's been aboard his high-speed warship defending us at the northern border for close to ten years, now. Countless meritorious deeds. Selected to be a Steam Knight, even at his young age. There's no telling how far he'll go.

steps.name: Noble Lady
steps.text: I hear he used to live in Londinium, I think right here in Auchterigg? Come to think, I've never heard anything about his family.

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: No matter his family, he's a pillar of Victoria.

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: Those with the honor of joining the Steam Knights are much different stuff than in times past. You know the type, the court suck-up playing sycophant to the monarch.

steps.name: Noble Lady
steps.text: Do I hear you ribbing at someone?

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: No, no, no, I would hardly. All I'm saying is, you see how His Majesty is surrounded by such fine company like Sir Charles, while there are people out there who've done nothing but rest their own laurels on their ancestry's honors. They're a pale shadow in—

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: Oh, dear... whose child is this? What are you barging about a dining hall for? You'll be dragged off forthwith if you bother His Majesty or His Grace!

steps.name: Noble Lady
steps.text: The dress... the hair color... Richard, she's...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The Cumberlands are NOT suck-ups!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We deserve steam armor! We'll charge enemy lines and give our lives for His Majesty and Victoria!

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: Miss Allerdale!

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: Sir Lord, Lady Martha, dreadfully sorry... the Miss is just feeling unwell right now, she doesn't mean to be rude to the guests. I should have put her to bed, the blame is mine.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: What do you mean the blame is yours, Ailshie?!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: No one is allowed to sully the Cumberlands' honor!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I'll become a brilliant steam knight, like my ancestors were!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Just wait until I grow up... I—I'll prove it to all of you!

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: Miss!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: *sigh* Don't run so fast!

steps.name: Maid Ailshie
steps.text: Sir, Madam, I need to fetch Mistress Allerdale. If you'll pardon me.

steps.name: Noble Lady
steps.text: Well, then. Our Miss Allerdale seems to be a fine, outspoken young girl.

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: Ah-heh... I thought we wouldn't have the chance to meet Miss Allerdale until the function tonight. How lucky of us, wouldn't you say, Martha?

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: Children can always afford to be innocent and naive. But whoever you may be...

steps.name: Noble Gentleman
steps.text: You won't get away without growing up.
Allerdale pants and gasps as she runs down a long, long passage.
She meant to seek her father, and she has no idea why she squeezes her way into this tiny room instead. It's far from both the ballroom and the Duke's study, practically neighboring the attic.
It's probably her fit of temper in this moment. She doesn't understand why her dad wants her gone, let alone why those posh-dressed visitors would say such things about the Cumberlands.
Every time life doesn't go her way, like when she loses a cricket match, or when her father the Duke misses her birthday party, this is where she comes, so she can have a chat with her old friend.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: They've all forgotten! You were the mightiest knight the Steam Knights ever had!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: But my father taught me that true heroes aren't afraid to give their lives, and they're even less afraid of being forgotten... so I shouldn't have argued with them.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I really want to grow up soon... and then I'll become one of the glorious Steam Knights too, and rout all our enemies!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I'll make every single person who ever talked down on the Cumberlands too ashamed to lift their heads!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I probably can't be as mighty as you were. But it'll be enough if I can just be half as... no... two-thirds as mighty.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Oh, but my father's said that as a Cumberland, I must hold the loftiest goals in mind! So...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You'll watch over me, can't you? I won't disappoint you, of course not!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: (...Is someone here?!)

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: (Is it Ailshie?)
She doesn't want to be dragged back to the hall so soon, so she stoops down, and with a single step leaps behind the steam armor she knows so well.
The dilapidated suit shields her as if it was protecting the young desendant. Her dainty frame is completely concealed.
Strangers' footsteps encroach.
Most of her view is blocked by the suit; Allerdale can't make out their faces. The most she can glimpse is their distorted reflections.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: Time's short, and chances are few. We need to confirm a few things.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: Are you sure this place is safe?

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: It's as secluded as any nook or cranny gets. The rest of the visitors are all in the ballroom, still. No one's noticed us leave.
No, someone has.
Not everyone loves to hang around in opulent halls with nothing to do, Allerdale thinks to herself.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: I don't understand. Why not choose today? The lion's finally left his den for once, and hardly any of the Guard are here.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: An assassination can't solve anything, and it won't.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: Don't tell me you're scared of the gallows, Mister Dutyman.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: Compared to your fear of poverty, I'd say getting hanged's a lighter affair for me.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: I'm SICK of spending my days with my brain and my wallet in others' hands. Chop-chop, please.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: Even if the elder dies, there's still the cubs. The crown will remain seated firm on their heads, muzzling us like draft animals.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: If we can kill one king, we can kill a second.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: Easier said. Listen, we have to be patient.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: The Steam Knights have all been sent out. By the time they return to Londinium, the dust will have settled.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: What will they do then?

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: The same as those paragon few. They'll do nothing for their own gain, and everything for Victoria. Even if it won't be handy to support our actions, they'll understand the decisions from on high.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: Then that leaves the Royal Guard.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: At the parade...

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: ...contain every Knight of the Tower... the key is seizing the city Defense Forces...

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: ...some dukes got fed up with it long ago...
Allerdale's face presses against cold plate, but sweat nevertheless drips down her forehead.
It grows harder and harder not to move a muscle, not to mention keeping her breathing stifled. The voices of the two figures grow gradually out of reach, then suddenly are right before her.
For a blink, she quivers, trying as hard as she can not to let her body slip into view, curling even her toes in.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: Has this lousy thing always been here?

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: First-generation steam knight armor.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: First-generation! That's over two hundred years ago. It's antique by now, isn't it? I'm sure it'd fetch a pretty price.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: Haven't you seen the family crest? It's House Cumberland's steam armor.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: Its old owner once stood before the Gaulish artillery in this, braced for three whole hours, just so His Majesty could flee unscathed together with his shattered people.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: Only during battlefield cleanup did people realize half this suit had been blown away, and the one inside may well have died soon after bombardment began—

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: —but even dead, knights still persevere in protecting their own king and kin, reluctant to fall so soon.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: And here you're the one of Gaulish blood—I'm surprised you like reminiscing on these nobles' heroic deeds more than I do.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: Fundamentally... I just bear respect for those we can call heroes.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: Their belongings and your measuring of things don't mix. Even if this duke's home is razed to ash one day, the Cumberlands would never sell off this armor.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: Hah... damned noble sense of honor, am I right? Utterly meaningless, in my view.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: He's welcome to watch from his ivory tower all he likes, along with the rest of the dukes. No matter who the city's ruler nominally is, it won't make the dukes' authority any worse for wear, at least for the moment.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: If he took the prudent path, then he wouldn't be Cumberland.

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: Why can't he just let go of his loyalty to the lions? With colossal change about to greet Victoria, you wish he'd recognize where his loyalty should lie, sooner rather than later.

spans.text: Why can't he just let go of his loyalty to the lions? With colossal change about to greet Victoria, you wish he'd recognize where his loyalty

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: What's going on down there?

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: More men than you can count have surrounded the Duke's manor.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: Quiet. Listen carefully.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Intruders... Palace underground...

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Blade... thieved...

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Seal off all major streets in Auchterigg... no one in or out...

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: Can you hear what they're saying down there?

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: They're searching for someone.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Indistinct Officer
steps.text: His Majesty's entire Guard has moved out.

steps.name: Obscured Merchant
steps.text: They couldn't know we're meeting here... could they? What do we do, sir?
A faint noise comes from in front of them, a sound like someone gently drawing breath.
Allerdale's heart pounds.
